assumptions.source: No public daily series. NGI trade press (paywalled, unverified) reports Agua Dulce 25-49 cents under Henry Hub in 2025-26 spot and forward markets.
No public daily series. Trade press (unverified): Katy usually under $0.20 below Henry Hub, about $1 below during the 2022-23 Freeport LNG outage, ~47 cents below in winter 2026/27 forwards.
Typical haul from a flaring pad to a rig or frac fleet in the same basin. Customer locations are not public, so this is a single adjustable distance, not a routed one.
Share of diesel-parity value given up to win the customer: covers their dual-fuel conversion, substitution limits, and the fact that off-road diesel is untaxed.
Multiplier on the straight-line gap between a flare and the nearest mapped road (OSRM snap distance). 1.0 is a lower bound; lease roads wind.
A small liquid heel is usually kept to hold the tank cold for the return trip; boil-off on a same-day haul is small.
Cryogenic tanks keep vapour space for boil-off. Does not bind: at 80,000 lb the load is weight-limited well below this fill.
Marketing, scheduling and interconnect fees at the delivery point. No public benchmark for virtual-pipeline volumes.
Multiplier on routed hub miles. Below 1: the gas is delivered to a nearer pipeline interconnect than the named hub; above 1: detours, permitted truck routes.
Day-cab tractor plus 40 ft container chassis. Consistent with Hexagon selling the TITAN4 (50,024 lb loaded) as US road-legal, which leaves at most 29,976 lb for tractor and chassis.
